What are your responsibilities? 
• Hygiene is essential for any kitchen employee. That is why you ensure every day that your working methods and finished products comply with all applicable standards.
• You strictly follow all safety regulations. You do everything possible to guarantee both quality and safety. 
Who are you?
• You have experience as a cook in a large-scale catering kitchen or an industrial kitchen. Experience in a production environment is a plus.
• You are able and willing to work in a rotating two-shift system. 
• The early shift starts at 4:30 AM and ends at 12:30 PM.
• The late shift starts at 12:45 PM and ends at 8:00 PM.

• Flexible – You like working as part of a team but can also work independently. In addition, you enjoy the variety of working with different products and tasks.

·        Proven experience with CAD software, preferably PTC Creo.

jobs.description:
Job description 
As a C driver at our company, you will start by transporting construction materials and machinery. This is done using different types of trucks, such as box trucks and crane trucks. You will not always be required to load and unload the cargo yourself, but occasionally your assistance may be needed. Do you have experience with a loading crane? That’s a plus! But don’t worry if you don’t, as you will receive internal training. If you already hold a C driving license, you also have the opportunity to progress to CE. This is your chance to further develop your career in the transport sector! What are you waiting for? Join our team and give your career a boost!

 Requirements 
  Start as a C Driver and Grow into CE Have you ever dreamed of hitting the road while taking your career to the next level? Then this is your chance! Start as a C driver and explore the opportunities to grow into a CE driver. Language skills In this role, it is important to have a good command of Dutch, French, and/or English. This not only helps in communication with customers but also broadens your opportunities in an increasingly international environment. Motivation to learn crane work We also offer you the opportunity to learn crane operation. Why let this chance pass you by? These additional skills increase your value on the job market and make you indispensable for future employers. It is not only an investment in your career, but also in your personal development. Why wait? Seize this opportunity to build a successful career as a driver. Now is the perfect time to take the step toward a challenging and rewarding future full of growth and new experiences. Take that first step today!

Do you want to wrap up our team?
 

Tropack is a family business, active as an industrial supplier and service provider. Our core business? Storing and packing goods, parts and spare parts for the non-food sector. This with a big smile, for more than 30 years.
 

As a close team, we offer new employees a warm second home. Short lines of communication and a human approach are key for us.

Location: Oostakker

• You check and sort used goods. 

• You find out which part it is: type of part, serial number, etc. 

• You perform a visual quality check based on instructions provided. 

• You record the necessary data per part in the computer system. 

• You store the parts in the predefined location after making the right decision. 

• You move goods using a stacker. 

• You report to your team leader. 
 

• You are a motivated employee who likes to roll up your sleeves and don’t mind getting dirty. 

• You enjoy working independently and know how to make proactive adjustments where necessary.  

• Working with a computer? No problem! 

• You can work at a fast pace and attaches great importance to delivering quality.  

• You are available to work full-time in shifts. One week, you will work from 6:00 AM to 2:00 PM, and the following week from 12:00 PM to 8:00 PM. 

• Fluent in English or Dutch.

•
